known_mechanics: ACTION1 to ACTION4 move the selected part by one cell
ACTION5 rotates the selected part by 90 degrees
ACTION6 selects the part under the clicked cell
hypotheses: ACTION5 is a rotation and therefore preserves the area a part covers
memory_in.goal: seat every part in its notch on this level
memory_in.current_plan: rotate the selected part until its notches line up, then nudge it into place
